mapper.select: SELECT process_id,status,current_step,waiting_for FROM order_process_managers WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('WAITING_RESULT','WAITING_RECONCILIATION') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_process_managers SET status='COMPENSATION_REQUIRED',last_error=#{error}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE process_id=#{processId}
mapper.select: SELECT process_id,order_id,status,current_step,waiting_for,attempts,result_deadline_at,last_error, recovered_by,recovery_reason,recovered_at FROM order_process_managers WHERE status IN ('WAITING_RECONCILIATION','COMPENSATION_REQUIRED','MANUAL_REVIEW') ORDER BY updated_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_process_managers WHERE process_id=#{processId}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_command_outbox SET status='PENDING',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), last_error=NULL WHERE process_id=#{processId}

UPDATE order_process_managers SET status='WAITING_RESULT',attempts=attempts+1, next_check_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),result_deadline_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, recovered_by=#{operator},recovery_reason=#{reason},recovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE process_id=#{processId}

UPDATE order_process_managers SET status='WAITING_RECONCILIATION',last_error='RESULT_TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status='WAITING_RESULT' AND result_deadline_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_process_managers(process_id,order_id,process_type,status,current_step,waiting_for,command_id, command_fingerprint,correlation_id,causation_id,traceparent,attempts,result_deadline_at,next_check_at, version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{processId},#{orderId},'CANCELLATION','WAITING_RESULT','WAITING_BOTH','PAYMENT_AND_INVENTORY', #{commandId},#{fingerprint},#{correlationId},#{causationId},#{traceparent},0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE order_result_inbox SET processing_status='REJECTED_OUT_OF_ORDER', error_detail='Cancellation waits for PAYMENT or INVENTORY' WHERE result_id=#{resultId}
UPDATE order_result_inbox SET processing_status='REJECTED_OUT_OF_ORDER', error_detail='Result type was already confirmed' WHERE result_id=#{resultId}
UPDATE order_process_managers SET current_step=#{step},waiting_for=#{waiting}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE process_id=#{processId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_command_outbox(command_id,process_id,order_id,target_service,command_type,payload_fingerprint, payload,status,attempts,next_attempt_at,result_deadline_at,correlation_id,causation_id,traceparent,created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{processId},#{orderId},#{target},#{type},#{fingerprint},#{payload},'PENDING',0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,#{correlationId},#{causationId},#{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_orders SET status=#{to},cancel_reason=COALESCE(#{reason},cancel_reason), carrier=COALESCE(#{carrier},carrier),tracking_number=COALESCE(#{tracking},tracking_number), cancelled_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='CANCELLED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE cancelled_at END, confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='CONFIRMED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE confirmed_at END, shipped_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='SHIPPED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE shipped_at END, received_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='RECEIVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE received_at END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=#{from} AND (#{to} NOT IN ('SHIPPED','REFUNDING') OR shipment_intent_key IS NULL) AND (#{to} NOT IN ('SHIPPED','REFUNDING') OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_package_allocations p WHERE p.order_id=shop_orders.id ))
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload_fingerprint,processing_status FROM order_remote_message_inbox WHERE message_id=#{messageId}
SELECT payload_fingerprint,processing_status FROM order_result_inbox WHERE result_id=#{resultId}
